verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a templates feature that lets you prefill properties and blocks when creating new objects, which supports reusable templates for recurring note types, but the evidence never explicitly confirms dynamic variable insertion (e.g., auto-populating today's date or a title placeholder) within templates. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of variable/placeholder support (date, title, etc.) in templates, and independent/hands-on confirmation of this workflow.
